title: AppendAssistantConversationTurnRequest
description: Request body of POST /api/assistant-conversations/:id/messages (HEL-663). Appends one or more Claude tool-message turns onto an existing, owned conversation -- the server re-writes the WHOLE transcript blob (no partial/append-in-place, design.md D2), never an incremental patch.

turns.description: One or more turns, each shaped like ClaudeToolMessage (com.helio.ai): { role: string, content: [...] }. Opaque to this schema (server-validated).
